item.title: VAT Removal, Pinewood Flooding, Straw Market Closure
item.ns0:title: VAT Removal, Pinewood Flooding, Straw Market Closure
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, the government announces plans to eliminate value-added tax on trust services and property transfers to strengthen the country's financial sector. Meanwhile, the iconic Bay Street Straw Market temporarily shuts its doors for deep cleaning and repairs, leaving visitors disappointed while local vendors weigh the impact. Frustrated Pinewood Gardens residents battle severe flooding once again following heavy rainfall, even as Grand Bahama business leaders sound the alarm over ongoing delays in redeveloping the island's international airport. Tune in for these top headlines, critical updates on local healthcare challenges, and your complete sports and weather forecast.
